question: How are the inner principles mapped onto the phonetic classes?
premises: The inner principles are located there by the sequence of speech levels.
In the a-class is the śiva principle.
In the group from ka to ha is the range extending up to śiva.
inference: The phonetic classes encode a graded deployment of principles from śiva through the full consonantal range.
uncertainties: The exact scope of śivāntakam in this mapping is compressed.
plain_english: There, by the sequence of the levels of speech, the inner principles are arranged: in the a-class is the śiva principle, and in the group from ka to ha is the range extending up to śiva.
